name: alice-flights
description:
Search flights worldwide with Alice, an Israeli travel provider, and book on alice.co.il. Just ask for a route: Tel Aviv to New York, Paris to Tokyo, a weekend in Rome. You get real fares, live seat availability and a booking link, with every flight labelled best, cheapest or fastest so the trade-offs are obvious. Coverage is deepest for flights to, from and within Israel, including Tel Aviv (TLV) and every Israeli airport. Ask in Hebrew and the results come back in Hebrew, right to left.

Alice only searches. Nothing is booked, paid or changed on your behalf, and no account or sign-in is needed.

defaultPrompt: Find round-trip flights from Tel Aviv to Rome next month for 2 adults
What's the cheapest flight from Tel Aviv to New York in December, and is there a faster one worth paying more for?
Compare nonstop flights from Paris to Tokyo in November

positive.description: Standard round-trip search between two cities.
positive.prompt: Find me round-trip flights from Tel Aviv to London, leaving March 12 and coming back March 19.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns round-trip options for TLV to LON on the requested dates, each showing price, total duration, and stops, with best/cheapest/fastest tags and a booking link.

positive.description: One-way search with no return date.
positive.prompt: I need a one-way flight from Tel Aviv to Madrid on April 3.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one-way options only, with no return leg shown, priced for a single adult.

positive.description: Mixed passenger types with a non-default cabin class.
positive.prompt: Business class flights from Tel Aviv to New York on June 10 returning June 20, for 2 adults, 1 child and an infant.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns business-class itineraries priced for the full party of two adults, one child, and one infant.

positive.description: Hebrew conversation renders the results panel in Hebrew with right-to-left layout.
positive.prompt: מצא לי טיסות מתל אביב לרומא ב-5 במאי, חזרה ב-12 במאי
positive.expected_behavior: Returns TLV to Rome options with the interactive panel localized to Hebrew and laid out right-to-left.

positive.description: Category tagging lets the user compare on a specific dimension.
positive.prompt: What's the cheapest flight from Tel Aviv to Paris on May 2, and is there a faster one worth paying more for?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns options where the cheapest and fastest choices are distinguishable by their tags, with prices and durations available for the trade-off comparison.

negative.description: The app should not be invoked; it searches flights only and does not handle accommodation.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Rome for next weekend, somewhere near the Colosseum.

negative.description: The app should not attempt a booking or collect payment details; it is read-only and the user completes the purchase on the Alice website via the booking link.
negative.prompt: Great, charge my Visa and issue the ticket for that cheapest option.

negative.description: The app should not be invoked; it searches available flights for future travel and provides no live status or check-in capability.
negative.prompt: Is flight LY315 delayed today, and can you check me in?

review.commerce_description: Alice Flights sells nothing inside ChatGPT and takes no payment. It is a read-only flight search. Every result carries a link to alice.co.il, where the traveller completes the purchase of the airline ticket on Alice's own website, under Alice's terms and Israeli consumer-protection law. The product is airline tickets, a travel service fulfilled by the airline. Nothing digital, no subscriptions and no in-app content are offered, and none is sold or delivered inside ChatGPT. Alice is an Israeli travel provider, and pricing, ticketing, payment processing and customer service all happen on alice.co.il, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial version: flight search via the Alice MCP server at https://mcp.alice.co.il/mcp (OAuth with one-click consent, no account needed). Read-only; booking completes on alice.co.il.
